title: Quarterly scenario mapping and cost guardrails for Private/VPC/on-prem roadmap
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: produce a defensible Q2 roadmap slice for Private/VPC/on-prem that ties release milestones to unit-cost sensitivity, cohort failure budgets, and clear gating criteria. Scope: roadmap scenarios (conservative/base/aggressive), a unit-cost sensitivity matrix across SKU and quantization options, rollout guardrails for regulated customers, and a dark-launch lane for enterprise beta partners. Deliverables: 1) Scenario mapping doc with decision criteria; 2) Cost model spreadsheet and sample dashboards; 3) Release gates & acceptance checklist; 4) Stakeholder approval package for Legal/Security/Sales; 5) Runbook for canary/fallback behavior. Acceptance criteria: - Three scenarios documented with capacity and cost thresholds - Cost model validated by infra and finance (±10%) - Rollout gates signed by SRE, Security, and Sales engineering - Demo dashboard for leadership showing cost per 1M tokens and tail-latency under each scenario - Dark-launch plan with two pilot customers and rollback thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Scenario doc reviewed and approved by Product, Infra, and Finance; 2) Cost model validated with sample workloads and annotated assumptions; 3) Rollout gates and failure-budget per cohort agreed; 4) Pilot customers identified and NDA/contract path cleared; 5) PRD and rollout runbook uploaded to Confluence and referenced in the release ticket.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0: Internal simulation and cost validation (Mar)
Phase 1: Dark launch with 2 pilot customers + isolated VPC (Apr)
Phase 2: Tranche-based activation for low-risk cohorts (May)
Phase 3: Broader activation once KPIs stable (Jun)
Rollback criteria: sustained 95th p99 latency > 2x baseline for 15 minutes OR cost per 1M tokens > scenario threshold for 24h.
notes: We need an explicit mapping between SKU/quantization choice and expected SLOs so sales can provide accurate TCO to customers. Include a compact one-page executive summary for C-suite. Coordinate with Solutions Eng to pre-generate pricing examples for top 10 prospects.
comments: 2025-02-11 - Initial scoping sync: Met with Infra (SRE), Finance, Legal to align on inputs. Agreed to surface both steady-state unit cost and burst pricing assumptions. Action: Luca to collect current quantization profiles and unit-cost deltas by 2025-02-17.
